_comment: Data components implemented by hand in src/level/component (a codec the schema cannot type yet: a dispatch, a recursive codec). The components generator skips them even when the schema types them fully, and says so. Key: the registry name.
minecraft:attribute_modifiers: entry display type is a dispatch
minecraft:can_break: block predicates dispatch on the property matcher
minecraft:can_place_on: block predicates dispatch on the property matcher
minecraft:consumable: consume effects are a recursive dispatch
minecraft:death_protection: consume effects are a recursive dispatch
minecraft:potion_contents: custom effects list carries a dispatch
minecraft:tooltip_display: hidden components are a set of registry ids with a custom codec
